title: General.
officialText:
In evaluating the physical properties of materials and methods of construction that are not capable of being designed
by approved engineering analysis or do not comply with applicable material design standards listed in Chapter 35, the structural
adequacy shall be predetermined based on the load test criteria established in this section.
